author: nflaig
content: when you say WSP, do you mean with a safety decay of 10, or 100, or any other value? the 33024 epoch value comes from phase0 and uses a safety decay of 100, see https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2131/ how the value was initially determined back then and rationale for it

author: barnabemonnot
content: Related but separate: In the context of quick slots, epoch durations would get shorter in wall-clock time. We're scaling the churn limits per epochs proportionally to keep the churn per second constant. I believe this then means that we should express block retention duration in wall-clock time rather than make it epoch-based too
